source.text: וְאַתָּ֞ה בֵּֽית־לֶ֣חֶם אֶפְרָ֗תָה צָעִיר֙ לִֽהְיוֹת֙ בְּאַלְפֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה מִמְּךָ֙ לִ֣י יֵצֵ֔א לִֽהְי֥וֹת מוֹשֵׁ֖ל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּמוֹצָאֹתָ֥יו מִקֶּ֖דֶם מִימֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, small to be among [the] thousands of Judah, from you for me will go out [one] to be ruler in Israel, and his goings out [are] from of old, from [the] days of antiquity.

en.L: And you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, [though] small to be among the thousands of Judah, \q from you [one] will come out for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} \q to be ruler in Israel, \q whose origins [are] from of old, from ancient days.
en.B: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, too small to be counted among the clans of Judah, \q from you one will come out for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} \q to be ruler over Israel, \q one whose origins are from of old, from ancient days.
en.R: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, are one of the least important towns among the clans of Judah. \q Yet from you will come for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} \q one who will rule over Israel, \q whose family line goes back to ancient times.

es.L: Y tú, Belén Efrata, pequeña para estar entre los millares de Judá, \q de ti {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} saldrá \q el que ha de ser gobernante en Israel, \q cuyos orígenes [son] desde antiguo, desde los días de antaño.
es.B: Pero tú, Belén Efrata, demasiado pequeña para contarte entre los clanes de Judá, \q de ti {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} saldrá \q el que será gobernante sobre Israel, \q uno cuyos orígenes vienen desde antiguo, desde tiempos remotos.
es.R: Pero tú, Belén Efrata, eres uno de los pueblos menos importantes entre los clanes de Judá. \q Sin embargo, de ti saldrá para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} \q uno que gobernará sobre Israel, \q cuya familia viene de tiempos muy antiguos.

fr.L: Et toi, Bethléem Éphrata, [bien que] petite pour être parmi les milliers de Juda, \q de toi sortira pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} \q celui qui doit gouverner en Israël, \q et ses origines remontent aux temps anciens, aux jours d’autrefois.
fr.B: Mais toi, Bethléem Éphrata, trop petite pour compter parmi les clans de Juda, \q de toi sortira pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} \q celui qui doit gouverner Israël, \q celui dont les origines remontent aux temps anciens, aux jours d’autrefois.
fr.R: Mais toi, Bethléem Éphrata, tu es l’une des villes les moins importantes parmi les clans de Juda. \q Pourtant, de toi sortira pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} \q celui qui gouvernera Israël, \q celui dont la famille remonte aux temps anciens.

sw.L: Nawe, Bethlehemu Efrata, [ingawa] u mdogo kuwa miongoni mwa maelfu ya Yuda, \q kutoka kwako atatoka kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} \q yeye atakayekuwa mtawala katika Israeli, \q ambaye asili yake ni tangu zamani, tangu siku za kale.
sw.B: Lakini wewe, Bethlehemu Efrata, mdogo mno kuhesabiwa miongoni mwa koo za Yuda, \q kutoka kwako atatoka kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} \q yeye atakayekuwa mtawala juu ya Israeli, \q ambaye asili yake ni tangu zamani, tangu siku za kale.
sw.R: Lakini wewe, Bethlehemu Efrata, u mmoja wa miji isiyo na umuhimu kati ya koo za Yuda. \q Hata hivyo, kutoka kwako atatoka kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} \q mtu atakayetawala Israeli, \q ambaye ukoo wake ni wa tangu zamani za kale.

vi.L: Còn ngươi, Bết-lê-hem Ép-ra-ta, [dù] nhỏ bé giữa hàng ngàn [gia tộc] của Giu-đa, \q từ ngươi sẽ có một người ra cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} \q để làm người cai trị trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, \q nguồn gốc người từ thuở xưa, từ những ngày thượng cổ.
vi.B: Còn ngươi, Bết-lê-hem Ép-ra-ta, quá nhỏ bé để được kể vào các gia tộc của Giu-đa, \q từ ngươi sẽ có một người ra cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} \q để cai trị Y-sơ-ra-ên, \q là người có nguồn gốc từ thuở xưa, từ những ngày thượng cổ.
vi.R: Còn ngươi, Bết-lê-hem Ép-ra-ta, là một trong những thành nhỏ bé nhất giữa các gia tộc của Giu-đa. \q Thế nhưng từ ngươi sẽ có một người ra cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q là người sẽ cai trị Y-sơ-ra-ên. \q Dòng dõi người có từ thời xa xưa.

ko.L: 그리고 너 베들레헴 에브라다야, 너는 유다의 천천 가운데 들기에는 작지만, \q 너에게서 나를 위하여 \q 이스라엘에서 다스릴 자가 나올 것이다. \q 그의 근원은 옛날부터, 아득한 날부터이다.
ko.B: 그러나 너 베들레헴 에브라다야, 너는 너무 작아서 유다의 가문들 가운데 들지도 못하지만, \q 너에게서 나를 위하여 한 사람이 나와 \q 이스라엘을 다스릴 자가 될 것이다. \q 그의 근원은 옛날부터, 아득한 날부터이다.
ko.R: 그러나 너 베들레헴 에브라다야, 너는 유다의 가문들 가운데 가장 보잘것없는 마을이다. \q 하지만 너에게서 나를 위하여 \q 이스라엘을 다스릴 사람이 나올 것이다. \q 그의 집안은 아주 오랜 옛날로 거슬러 올라간다.

decisions.choice: This verse is 5:1 in the Hebrew text, 5:2 in Bibles that follow the Latin and later numbering
decisions.reason: Because those Bibles begin chapter 5 one verse earlier (see the note at 4:14), Hebrew 5:1-14 is 5:2-15 in many Bibles. Open Word Bible follows the Hebrew numbering, and Micah is cited by the Hebrew numbers.

decisions.choice: Bethlehem Ephrathah: David's home town, a small place south of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Bethlehem lies about six miles south of Jerusalem. Ephrathah was its clan or district name (Genesis 35:19; Ruth 4:11), and David was "the son of an Ephrathite of Bethlehem in Judah" named Jesse (1 Samuel 17:12). The ruler promised here comes from the same humble place as David: a new David, from David's line, as Isaiah 11:1 promises a shoot from the stump of Jesse. In 4:14 the ruler of Israel is struck on the cheek; here the LORD promises another.

decisions.choice: the thousands of Judah: Judah's clans
decisions.reason: The word means "thousand", and also a clan, a division of a tribe that could be counted on to send its unit of fighting men (Judges 6:15, where Gideon says "my clan is the weakest in Manasseh"; 1 Samuel 10:19). Bethlehem was too small to rank among the clans of Judah.

decisions.choice: Matthew 2:6 quotes this verse in a different form
decisions.reason: When Herod asks where the Messiah is to be born, the chief priests and scribes answer "In Bethlehem of Judea" and cite this verse (Matthew 2:5-6; compare John 7:42). Matthew's form differs: it says that Bethlehem is "by no means least among the rulers of Judah", where Micah calls it small among the clans of Judah, and it closes with the words God spoke to David, "who will shepherd my people Israel" (2 Samuel 5:2). Matthew adapts the text to show what the ruler's birth has done for the small town. The verse here is translated from the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: whose origins are from of old, from ancient days: his line reaches back to long ago
alternatives: whose goings forth are from eternity
decisions.reason: The word for "origins" means goings out, descent or source; it is found elsewhere only in 2 Kings 10:27, where it means a latrine, a different sense. The two time phrases mean "long ago" and "days of old"; the second is used of David's time in Amos 9:11 ("as in the days of old") and of Israel's past in Micah 7:14. Read this way, the ruler's descent goes back to David and beyond, an ancient and chosen line. The same words can also be read as "from eternity", and many Christian readers have taken the verse to speak of the ruler's existence before his birth. The Hebrew allows that reading but does not require it, and it is not the sense followed here.

decisions.choice: thousands (L); clans (B, R); ruler, with no setting for pronouns for God; whose origins are from of old, from ancient days (L, B); whose family line goes back to ancient times (R)
decisions.reason: As set for this verse, Balanced and Readable say "clans" (m3), and Readable says what "origins" means on the reading chosen (m5). The ruler is a figure distinct from the LORD, who speaks of him as coming "for me", so no pronoun for him takes the setting for pronouns for God; only "me" does, since the LORD is speaking.

decisions.choice: [though] small (L); too small to be counted among (B); one of the least important towns among (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "small to be among", meaning too small to be reckoned as one of them. Readable puts it as a plain comparison.

decisions.choice: "Belén", "Judá", "saldrá", as Matthew 2:6; "los millares de Judá" (L), "los clanes de Judá" (B, R); "gobernante" for moshel
decisions.reason: Matthew 2:6 quotes this verse in a form that follows the Greek (m4): Bethlehem is "by no means least among the rulers of Judah", and the one who comes is a "caudillo" (L) or "jefe" (B, R) who will shepherd God's people. The shared words are kept so the quotation can be seen, but Micah's Hebrew is translated: clans, not rulers, and "gobernante" for moshel.

decisions.choice: "me" / "mí" (God) takes the deity_pronoun span; the ruler takes none
decisions.reason: The ruler is distinct from the LORD, who speaks of him as coming "for me", as the English sets it.

decisions.choice: "Bethléem", "Juda", "sortira", as Matthew 2:6; "les milliers de Juda" (L), "les clans de Juda" (B, R), not Matthew's "les chefs de Juda"; "gouverner" for moshel, with no deity_pronoun span on the ruler
decisions.reason: Matthew quotes the verse in a form that follows the Greek (m4); the shared words are kept so the quotation is visible, and the Hebrew's clans and ruler are translated as such, as the term sheet sets.

decisions.choice: "maelfu ya Yuda" (L), "koo za Yuda" (B, R); "atatoka", "Bethlehemu", "Yuda" as Matthew 2:6; "mtawala" for moshel, with no span on the ruler; "kwa ajili yangu" for "for me"
decisions.reason: Matthew 2:6 has "watawala wa Yuda" and "kiongozi" from the Greek (m4); Micah's Hebrew speaks of clans and a ruler. "Kwa ajili yangu" keeps a free pronoun for God, so the deity_pronoun setting has a word to act on.

decisions.choice: "Còn ngươi, Bết-lê-hem Ép-ra-ta"; "hàng ngàn [gia tộc]" (L), "các gia tộc của Giu-đa" (B, R); "người cai trị", lowercase "người" with no span; "nguồn gốc người từ thuở xưa, từ những ngày thượng cổ" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Matthew 2:6 quotes the verse from the Greek, with "các lãnh tụ" and "người lãnh đạo" (m4). Literal keeps the Hebrew "thousands", the clans of Judah (m3). The ruler is distinct from the LORD who speaks, so he takes no deity span.

decisions.choice: "너 베들레헴 에브라다야"; "유다의 천천" (L), "유다의 가문들" (B, R); "다스릴 자", with no -시-; "그의 근원은 옛날부터, 아득한 날부터이다" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Matthew 2:6 has "유다 땅 베들레헴아" and "통치자들" from the Greek (m4); Micah's Hebrew names Ephrathah and the clans of Judah. The ruler is not the LORD, who speaks of him, so he takes no honorific.

source.text: לָכֵ֣ן יִתְּנֵ֔ם עַד־עֵ֥ת יוֹלֵדָ֖ה יָלָ֑דָה וְיֶ֣תֶר אֶחָ֔יו יְשׁוּב֖וּן עַל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore he will give them up until [the] time [when one] giving birth has given birth; and [the] rest of his brothers will return to [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: Therefore {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will give them up \q until the time [when] she who is in labor has given birth, \q and the remainder of his brothers will return \q to the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will abandon them \q until the woman in labor has borne her child; \q then the rest of his kinsmen will come back \q to the people of Israel.
en.R: So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will leave {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people in the power of their enemies \q until the woman who is in labor has her child. \q Then the rest of the ruler's family \q will come back to join the people of Israel.

es.L: Por tanto, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los entregará \q hasta el tiempo [en que] la que está de parto haya dado a luz, \q y el resto de sus hermanos volverá \q a los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los abandonará \q hasta que la que está de parto haya dado a luz; \q entonces el resto de sus parientes volverá \q al pueblo de Israel.
es.R: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dejará a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo en poder de sus enemigos \q hasta que la mujer que está de parto tenga a su hijo. \q Entonces el resto de la familia del gobernante \q volverá para unirse al pueblo de Israel.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les livrera \q jusqu’au temps [où] celle qui enfante aura enfanté, \q et le reste de ses frères reviendra \q aux {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les abandonnera \q jusqu’à ce que celle qui est en travail ait mis au monde son enfant ; \q alors le reste de ses frères reviendra \q au peuple d’Israël.
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} laissera {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple au pouvoir de ses ennemis \q jusqu’à ce que la femme en travail ait son enfant. \q Ensuite, le reste de la famille du chef \q reviendra rejoindre le peuple d’Israël.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo atawaacha \q mpaka wakati yeye aliye na utungu atakapokuwa amezaa, \q na mabaki ya ndugu zake watarudi \q kwa wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo atawaacha \q mpaka mwanamke aliye na utungu atakapojifungua; \q ndipo ndugu zake waliobaki watarudi \q kwa watu wa Israeli.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawaacha watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mikononi mwa adui zao \q mpaka mwanamke aliye na utungu atakapojifungua mtoto wake. \q Ndipo jamaa wengine wa mtawala huyo \q watarudi kujiunga na watu wa Israeli.

vi.L: Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ phó họ \q cho đến kỳ người đàn bà chuyển dạ đã sinh nở, \q và phần còn lại của anh em người sẽ trở về \q với con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ bỏ mặc họ \q cho đến khi người đàn bà chuyển dạ sinh con; \q bấy giờ những anh em còn lại của người sẽ trở về \q cùng dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Vì thế {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ để dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong tay kẻ thù \q cho đến khi người đàn bà chuyển dạ sinh con. \q Bấy giờ những người còn lại trong gia đình của người cai trị \q sẽ trở về hiệp với dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그러므로 그분께서 그들을 넘겨주실 것이다, \q 해산하는 여인이 아이를 낳을 때까지. \q 그리고 그의 형제들 가운데 남은 자들이 \q 이스라엘 자손에게로 돌아올 것이다.
ko.B: 그러므로 그분께서 그들을 버려두실 것이다, \q 해산하는 여인이 아이를 낳을 때까지. \q 그때에 그의 남은 형제들이 \q 이스라엘 백성에게 돌아올 것이다.
ko.R: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 백성을 원수들의 손에 버려두실 것이다, \q 아기를 낳으려는 여인이 아이를 낳을 때까지. \q 그때에 그 통치자의 남은 가족들이 \q 이스라엘 백성에게 돌아와 함께할 것이다.

decisions.choice: he will give them up: the LORD will leave his people to their enemies for a time
decisions.reason: "He" is the LORD, who speaks in verse 1; "them" are his people. To "give up" is to hand over to enemies (1 Kings 14:16; Hosea 11:8). The ruler of verse 1 will not come at once; first comes the time of distress of 4:9-14.

decisions.choice: she who is in labor: the mother of the ruler
decisions.reason: The words recall Isaiah 7:14, where a young woman is with child and will bear a son named Immanuel; Isaiah and Micah spoke in the same years. The woman may be the ruler's mother; she may also be Zion, pictured in labor in 4:9-10, whose pains end when the promised ruler is born. The text does not name her.

decisions.choice: the rest of his brothers will return: the scattered Israelites rejoin their people
decisions.reason: "His brothers" are the ruler's fellow Israelites. Those still scattered will come back and be one people again with the sons of Israel, as Hosea 2:2 and Ezekiel 37:15-22 promise for Judah and Israel. The preposition may mean "return to" or "return together with".

decisions.choice: the LORD will leave his people in the power of their enemies; the ruler's family (R)
decisions.reason: Readable names the one who gives his people up (m1) and the ruler whose family is meant. "Abandon" (B) and "leave ... in the power of" (R) say what "give up" means here.

decisions.choice: "los hijos de Israel", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" already includes daughters, as the term sheet sets for the sons of Israel.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun span for "he" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Swahili says "he" only in the verb prefix ("atawaacha"), which cannot take a capital; Readable names the LORD, as the English does.

source.text: וְעָמַ֗ד וְרָעָה֙ בְּעֹ֣ז יְהוָ֔ה בִּגְא֕וֹן שֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו וְיָשָׁ֕בוּ כִּֽי־עַתָּ֥ה יִגְדַּ֖ל עַד־אַפְסֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will stand and shepherd in [the] strength of Yahweh, in [the] majesty of [the] name of Yahweh his God; and they will dwell, for now he will be great to [the] ends of [the] earth.

en.L: And he will stand and shepherd by the strength of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q by the majesty of the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God; \q and so they will dwell [secure], \q for now he will be great to the ends of the earth.
en.B: He will stand firm and shepherd his flock by the power of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q by the majesty of the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God. \q His people will live in safety, \q for then his greatness will reach to the ends of the earth.
en.R: He will stand and care for his people like a shepherd, with the strength {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gives him \q and the majesty of the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} his God. \q His people will live in safety, \q because then he will be honored everywhere on earth.

es.L: Y él se mantendrá y pastoreará con la fuerza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q con la majestad del nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios; \q y habitarán [seguros], \q porque ahora será grande hasta los confines de la tierra.
es.B: Él se mantendrá firme y pastoreará su rebaño con el poder {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q con la majestad del nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios. \q Su pueblo vivirá seguro, \q porque entonces su grandeza llegará hasta los confines de la tierra.
es.R: Él se levantará y cuidará de su pueblo como un pastor, con la fuerza que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le da \q y con la majestad del nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios. \q Su pueblo vivirá seguro, \q porque entonces será honrado en toda la tierra.

fr.L: Et il se tiendra là et fera paître par la force {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q par la majesté du nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son Dieu ; \q et ils demeureront [en sécurité], \q car maintenant il sera grand jusqu’aux extrémités de la terre.
fr.B: Il se tiendra ferme et fera paître son troupeau par la puissance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q par la majesté du nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son Dieu. \q Son peuple vivra en sécurité, \q car alors sa grandeur s’étendra jusqu’aux extrémités de la terre.
fr.R: Il se lèvera et prendra soin de son peuple comme un berger, avec la force que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui donne \q et la majesté du nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} son Dieu. \q Son peuple vivra en sécurité, \q car alors il sera honoré partout sur la terre.

sw.L: Naye atasimama na kuchunga kwa nguvu za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kwa enzi ya jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake; \q nao watakaa [salama], \q kwa maana sasa atakuwa mkuu hata miisho ya dunia.
sw.B: Atasimama imara na kulichunga kundi lake kwa uwezo wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kwa enzi ya jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake. \q Watu wake wataishi salama, \q kwa maana wakati huo ukuu wake utafika hadi miisho ya dunia.
sw.R: Atasimama na kuwatunza watu wake kama mchungaji, kwa nguvu ambazo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anampa \q na kwa enzi ya jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wake. \q Watu wake wataishi salama, \q kwa sababu wakati huo ataheshimiwa kila mahali duniani.

vi.L: Người sẽ đứng vững và chăn dắt bởi sức mạnh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q bởi sự uy nghiêm của danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời người; \q và họ sẽ ở [yên ổn], \q vì bấy giờ người sẽ vĩ đại đến tận cùng trái đất.
vi.B: Người sẽ đứng vững và chăn dắt bầy chiên mình bằng quyền năng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q bằng sự uy nghiêm của danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời người. \q Dân người sẽ sống an ổn, \q vì bấy giờ sự vĩ đại của người sẽ lan đến tận cùng trái đất.
vi.R: Người sẽ đứng lên chăm sóc dân mình như người chăn chiên, bằng sức mạnh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho \q và bằng sự uy nghiêm của danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời người. \q Dân người sẽ sống an ổn, \q vì bấy giờ người sẽ được tôn kính khắp nơi trên đất.

ko.L: 그가 서서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 능력으로 목자 노릇을 하고, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 그의 하나님의 이름의 위엄으로 [그리할 것이다]. \q 그리고 그들이 [안전하게] 살 것이니, \q 이제 그가 땅끝까지 크게 될 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그가 굳건히 서서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 능력으로 자기 양 떼를 칠 것이다, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 그의 하나님의 이름의 위엄으로. \q 그의 백성은 안전하게 살 것이다. \q 그때에 그의 위대함이 땅끝까지 미칠 것이기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그가 일어나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 주시는 힘으로, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 그의 하나님의 위엄 있는 이름으로 목자처럼 자기 백성을 돌볼 것이다. \q 그의 백성은 안전하게 살 것이다. \q 그때에 그가 온 땅에서 존경받을 것이기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: he will stand and shepherd: he will rule his people and care for them
decisions.reason: Kings in the ancient world were called shepherds, and David was a shepherd made king (2 Samuel 5:2; Psalm 78:70-72). To stand is to remain firm in office. The ruler of verse 1 will lead and protect, unlike the leaders who fed on the flock (3:1-3; compare Ezekiel 34:23).

decisions.choice: in the strength of the LORD ... his God: the ruler acts by the LORD's power, as his servant
decisions.reason: The ruler rules by a strength that is not his own; the LORD is "his God". The verse sets him apart from the LORD and under him, as the king of Psalm 2 and Psalm 72 is the LORD's anointed. "The name of the LORD" is the LORD himself as he has made himself known.

decisions.choice: they will dwell, for now he will be great: his people will live securely because his rule reaches everywhere
decisions.reason: The verb means to sit, dwell or remain, and is used without an object: the people will live settled and secure (compare 4:4). "Now" means "at that time". The ruler's greatness to the ends of the earth echoes the promises to the king in Psalm 2:8 and 72:8.

decisions.choice: shepherd his flock (B); care for his people like a shepherd (R); [secure] (L); in safety (B, R); be honored everywhere on earth (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the shepherd picture means and that the dwelling is secure (m3). The ruler takes no setting for pronouns for God (see verse 1).

decisions.choice: "người" for the ruler, lowercase, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The ruler acts by the LORD's strength and calls him "his God" (m2), so he is kept apart from the LORD, as the term sheet sets for the ruler of Micah 5.

source.text: וְהָיָ֥ה זֶ֖ה שָׁל֑וֹם אַשּׁ֣וּר׀כִּֽי־יָב֣וֹא בְאַרְצֵ֗נוּ וְכִ֤י יִדְרֹךְ֙ בְּאַרְמְנֹתֵ֔ינוּ וַהֲקֵמֹ֤נוּ עָלָיו֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה רֹעִ֔ים וּשְׁמֹנָ֖ה נְסִיכֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be this [one] peace. Assyria, when it comes into our land and when it treads on our fortresses, we will raise against it seven shepherds and eight princes of humankind.

en.L: And this one will be peace. \q When Assyria comes into our land and when it treads on our fortresses, \q then we will raise up against it seven shepherds \q and eight princes of men.
en.B: And he will be our peace. \q When the Assyrians invade our land and march into our strongholds, \q we will raise up seven shepherds against it, \q eight leaders of the people.
en.R: And he will bring peace. \q When the Assyrians invade our land and march into our forts, \q we will send out seven shepherds to fight them, \q even eight leaders, more than enough.

es.L: Y este será paz. \q Cuando Asiria venga a nuestra tierra y cuando pise nuestras fortalezas, \q entonces levantaremos contra ella siete pastores \q y ocho príncipes de hombres.
es.B: Y él será nuestra paz. \q Cuando los asirios invadan nuestra tierra y entren en nuestras fortalezas, \q levantaremos contra ellos siete pastores, \q ocho jefes del pueblo.
es.R: Y él traerá la paz. \q Cuando los asirios invadan nuestra tierra y entren en nuestros fuertes, \q enviaremos siete pastores a pelear contra ellos, \q y hasta ocho jefes, más que suficientes.

fr.L: Et celui-ci sera la paix. \q Quand l’Assyrie viendra dans notre pays et quand elle foulera nos forteresses, \q nous susciterons contre elle sept bergers \q et huit princes d’entre les hommes.
fr.B: Et lui sera notre paix. \q Quand les Assyriens envahiront notre pays et marcheront sur nos places fortes, \q nous dresserons contre eux sept bergers, \q huit chefs du peuple.
fr.R: Et il apportera la paix. \q Quand les Assyriens envahiront notre pays et entreront dans nos forteresses, \q nous enverrons sept bergers les combattre, \q et même huit chefs, plus qu’il n’en faut.

sw.L: Na huyu atakuwa amani. \q Ashuru atakapokuja katika nchi yetu na atakapokanyaga ngome zetu, \q ndipo tutainua dhidi yake wachungaji saba \q na wakuu wanane wa wanadamu.
sw.B: Naye atakuwa amani yetu. \q Waashuru watakapovamia nchi yetu na kuingia katika ngome zetu, \q tutawainulia wachungaji saba, \q viongozi wanane wa watu.
sw.R: Naye ataleta amani. \q Waashuru watakapoivamia nchi yetu na kuingia katika ngome zetu, \q tutawatuma wachungaji saba kupigana nao, \q hata viongozi wanane, zaidi ya wanaohitajika.

vi.L: Và người này sẽ là sự bình an. \q Khi A-si-ri đến trong xứ chúng ta và khi nó giày đạp các đồn lũy chúng ta, \q thì chúng ta sẽ dấy lên nghịch cùng nó bảy người chăn \q và tám thủ lĩnh trong loài người.
vi.B: Người sẽ là sự bình an của chúng ta. \q Khi quân A-si-ri xâm chiếm xứ chúng ta và tiến vào các đồn lũy chúng ta, \q chúng ta sẽ dấy lên bảy người chăn chống lại chúng, \q tám người lãnh đạo của dân.
vi.R: Người sẽ đem lại bình an. \q Khi quân A-si-ri xâm chiếm xứ chúng ta và tiến vào các đồn lũy chúng ta, \q chúng ta sẽ sai bảy người chăn đi đánh chúng, \q thậm chí tám người lãnh đạo, nhiều hơn mức cần.

ko.L: 그리고 이 사람이 평화가 될 것이다. \q 앗시리아가 우리 땅에 들어오고 우리 요새들을 짓밟을 때에, \q 우리가 그에 맞서 일곱 목자와 \q 사람 가운데 여덟 지도자를 세울 것이다.
ko.B: 그가 우리의 평화가 될 것이다. \q 앗시리아 사람들이 우리 땅을 침략하고 우리 요새들로 쳐들어올 때에, \q 우리가 일곱 목자를 세워 그들에 맞서게 하고, \q 백성의 지도자 여덟을 세울 것이다.
ko.R: 그가 평화를 가져올 것이다. \q 앗시리아 사람들이 우리 땅을 침략하고 우리 요새로 쳐들어오면, \q 우리는 일곱 목자를 보내 그들과 싸우게 할 것이다. \q 여덟 지도자까지, 넉넉하고도 남을 만큼 보낼 것이다.

decisions.choice: this one will be peace: the ruler himself brings peace
alternatives: this will be the peace: the deliverance described next
decisions.reason: "This one" most likely means the ruler of verses 1-3: he will be the source of his people's peace, their safety and well-being. It may also point forward: "this is how there will be peace", in the victory over Assyria. Isaiah 9:5 calls the coming king "Prince of Peace", and Ephesians 2:14 says of Christ, "he himself is our peace".

decisions.choice: Assyria: the great enemy of Micah's day
decisions.reason: Assyria destroyed Samaria in 722 BC and invaded Judah in 701 BC, taking its fortified cities (2 Kings 18:13). Here it stands for the enemy that will invade and be driven back. Later prophets use the name for the world power of their own time (Zechariah 10:10-11).

decisions.choice: seven shepherds and eight princes: as many leaders as are needed, and more
decisions.reason: Hebrew poetry names a number and then the next one up to mean "many, and more than enough" (Ecclesiastes 11:2; Amos 1:3). "Shepherds" are leaders, as in verse 3; "princes of men" are human leaders. They serve under the ruler who is the people's peace.

decisions.choice: this one will be peace (L); he will be our peace (B); he will bring peace (R); princes of men (L); leaders of the people (B); more than enough (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable take "this one" as the ruler (m1). Readable explains the numbers (m3). "Men" at Literal means human beings set against God; it takes no setting, as these leaders are pictured as warriors.

source.text: וְרָע֞וּ אֶת־אֶ֤רֶץ אַשּׁוּר֙ בַּחֶ֔רֶב וְאֶת־אֶ֥רֶץ נִמְרֹ֖ד בִּפְתָחֶ֑יהָ וְהִצִּיל֙ מֵֽאַשּׁ֔וּר כִּֽי־יָב֣וֹא בְאַרְצֵ֔נוּ וְכִ֥י יִדְרֹ֖ךְ בִּגְבוּלֵֽנוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And they will shepherd [the] land of Assyria with the sword, and [the] land of Nimrod at its entrances; and he will deliver from Assyria when it comes into our land and when it treads within our border.

en.L: And they will shepherd the land of Assyria by the sword, \q and the land of Nimrod at its entrances; \q and he will deliver [us] from Assyria \q when it comes into our land \q and when it treads within our borders.
en.B: They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, \q the land of Nimrod at its gates. \q He will rescue us from Assyria \q when it invades our land \q and marches across our borders.
en.R: They will rule Assyria with their swords. \q They will take control of Nimrod's land at its gates. \q Our ruler will save us from the Assyrians \q when they invade our land \q and march into our territory.

es.L: Y pastorearán la tierra de Asiria con la espada, \q y la tierra de Nimrod en sus entradas; \q y él [nos] librará de Asiria \q cuando venga a nuestra tierra \q y cuando pise dentro de nuestras fronteras.
es.B: Gobernarán la tierra de Asiria con la espada, \q la tierra de Nimrod en sus puertas. \q Él nos librará de Asiria \q cuando invada nuestra tierra \q y cruce nuestras fronteras.
es.R: Gobernarán Asiria con sus espadas. \q Dominarán la tierra de Nimrod hasta sus puertas. \q Nuestro gobernante nos salvará de los asirios \q cuando invadan nuestra tierra \q y entren en nuestro territorio.

fr.L: Et ils feront paître le pays d’Assyrie par l’épée, \q et le pays de Nimrod à ses portes ; \q et il [nous] délivrera de l’Assyrie \q quand elle viendra dans notre pays \q et quand elle foulera notre territoire.
fr.B: Ils gouverneront le pays d’Assyrie par l’épée, \q le pays de Nimrod à ses portes. \q Il nous délivrera de l’Assyrie \q quand elle envahira notre pays \q et franchira nos frontières.
fr.R: Ils domineront l’Assyrie avec leurs épées. \q Ils prendront le contrôle du pays de Nimrod jusqu’à ses portes. \q Notre chef nous sauvera des Assyriens \q quand ils envahiront notre pays \q et entreront dans notre territoire.

sw.L: Nao wataichunga nchi ya Ashuru kwa upanga, \q na nchi ya Nimrodi katika malango yake; \q naye atatuokoa kutoka kwa Ashuru \q atakapokuja katika nchi yetu \q na atakapokanyaga ndani ya mipaka yetu.
sw.B: Wataitawala nchi ya Ashuru kwa upanga, \q nchi ya Nimrodi katika malango yake. \q Atatuokoa kutoka kwa Ashuru \q atakapoivamia nchi yetu \q na kupita mipaka yetu.
sw.R: Wataitawala Ashuru kwa panga zao. \q Wataitwaa nchi ya Nimrodi katika malango yake. \q Mtawala wetu atatuokoa kutoka kwa Waashuru \q watakapoivamia nchi yetu \q na kuingia katika eneo letu.

vi.L: Họ sẽ dùng gươm chăn dắt xứ A-si-ri, \q và xứ của Nim-rốt tại các cửa ngõ nó; \q người sẽ giải cứu [chúng ta] khỏi A-si-ri \q khi nó đến trong xứ chúng ta \q và khi nó giày đạp trong bờ cõi chúng ta.
vi.B: Họ sẽ dùng gươm cai trị xứ A-si-ri, \q cai trị xứ của Nim-rốt tại các cổng thành nó. \q Người sẽ giải cứu chúng ta khỏi A-si-ri \q khi nó xâm chiếm xứ chúng ta \q và tràn qua bờ cõi chúng ta.
vi.R: Họ sẽ dùng gươm cai trị A-si-ri. \q Họ sẽ làm chủ xứ của Nim-rốt tại các cổng thành nó. \q Người cai trị của chúng ta sẽ cứu chúng ta khỏi quân A-si-ri \q khi chúng xâm chiếm xứ chúng ta \q và tiến vào lãnh thổ chúng ta.

ko.L: 그들이 칼로 앗시리아 땅을 칠 것이고, \q 니므롯의 땅을 그 어귀에서 칠 것이다. \q 그가 앗시리아에게서 [우리를] 건져 낼 것이다, \q 앗시리아가 우리 땅에 들어오고 \q 우리 경계 안을 짓밟을 때에.
ko.B: 그들이 칼로 앗시리아 땅을 다스리고, \q 니므롯의 땅을 그 성문에서 다스릴 것이다. \q 그가 우리를 앗시리아에게서 구해 낼 것이다, \q 앗시리아가 우리 땅을 침략하고 \q 우리 국경을 넘어올 때에.
ko.R: 그들은 칼로 앗시리아를 다스릴 것이다. \q 니므롯의 땅을 그 성문에서부터 차지할 것이다. \q 우리의 통치자가 앗시리아 사람들에게서 우리를 구해 낼 것이다, \q 그들이 우리 땅을 침략하고 \q 우리 영토로 쳐들어올 때에.

decisions.choice: shepherd ... with the sword: rule by force
decisions.reason: The verb is "shepherd" again (verses 3-4), here in a hard sense: to rule, even to crush. Psalm 2:9 uses a similar picture of breaking the nations with an iron rod. The invader is invaded.

decisions.choice: the land of Nimrod: Mesopotamia, the home of Assyria and Babylon
decisions.reason: Genesis 10:8-12 says that Nimrod, a mighty hunter, ruled in Babel and other cities of Shinar and built Nineveh. His land is the land between the rivers, the heartland of Assyria.

decisions.choice: at its entrances: at its gates or passes
decisions.reason: The word means openings or entrances, the gates of cities or the passes into a land. A small change in the vowels gives "with the drawn sword", which would match "with the sword" in the line before. The Hebrew as it stands makes sense and is kept.

decisions.choice: he will deliver: the ruler rescues his people
decisions.reason: "He" is the ruler of verses 1-4, who is the people's peace. The verse repeats the end of verse 4, "when Assyria comes into our land", to show that the threat is answered.

decisions.choice: [us] (L); us (B); Our ruler (R)
decisions.reason: The verb has no object; "us" is supplied from "our land". Readable names the ruler (m4).

decisions.choice: "칠 것이다" (L) for "shepherd"
decisions.reason: Korean 치다 means both to tend a flock and to strike, so Literal keeps the shepherd verb of verses 3-4 in its hard sense here (m1).

source.text: וְהָיָ֣ה׀שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֗ב בְּקֶ֨רֶב֙ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים כְּטַל֙ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה כִּרְבִיבִ֖ים עֲלֵי־עֵ֑שֶׂב אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־יְקַוֶּה֙ לְאִ֔ישׁ וְלֹ֥א יְיַחֵ֖ל לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be [the] remnant of Jacob in [the] midst of peoples many like dew from Yahweh, like showers on grass, which does not wait for a man and does not hope for [the] sons of humankind.

en.L: And the remnant of Jacob will be amid many peoples \q like dew from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q like heavy showers on grass, \q which does not wait for anyone \q and does not hope for {{gender:human beings|the sons of men}}.
en.B: The remnant of Jacob will be among many peoples \q like dew sent by {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q like showers on the grass, \q which wait for no one \q and depend on no human being.
en.R: The people of Jacob who are left will live among many nations. \q They will be like dew from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q like rain falling on the grass. \q Dew and rain do not wait for anyone. \q No human being can make them come.

es.L: Y el remanente de Jacob estará en medio de muchos pueblos \q como rocío {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q como lluvias abundantes sobre la hierba, \q que no espera a nadie \q ni aguarda a {{gender:los seres humanos|los hijos de los hombres}}.
es.B: El remanente de Jacob estará entre muchos pueblos \q como rocío enviado por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q como lluvia sobre la hierba, \q que no espera a nadie \q ni depende de ningún ser humano.
es.R: Los de Jacob que queden vivirán entre muchas naciones. \q Serán como el rocío que viene {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q como la lluvia que cae sobre la hierba. \q El rocío y la lluvia no esperan a nadie. \q Ningún ser humano puede hacerlos venir.

fr.L: Et le reste de Jacob sera au milieu de peuples nombreux \q comme une rosée venant {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q comme des averses sur l’herbe, \q qui n’attend personne \q et n’espère rien des {{gender:êtres humains|fils des hommes}}.
fr.B: Le reste de Jacob sera parmi des peuples nombreux \q comme une rosée envoyée par {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q comme des averses sur l’herbe, \q qui n’attendent personne \q et ne dépendent d’aucun être humain.
fr.R: Ceux de Jacob qui resteront vivront parmi beaucoup de nations. \q Ils seront comme la rosée qui vient {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q comme la pluie qui tombe sur l’herbe. \q La rosée et la pluie n’attendent personne. \q Aucun être humain ne peut les faire venir.

sw.L: Na mabaki ya Yakobo yatakuwa katikati ya watu wengi \q kama umande utokao kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kama manyunyu juu ya majani, \q yasiyomngoja mtu yeyote \q wala kuwatumainia wanadamu.
sw.B: Mabaki ya Yakobo yatakuwa kati ya watu wengi \q kama umande uliotumwa na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kama manyunyu juu ya majani, \q yasiyomngoja mtu \q wala kumtegemea binadamu yeyote.
sw.R: Watu wa Yakobo waliobaki wataishi kati ya mataifa mengi. \q Watakuwa kama umande kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kama mvua inayonyesha juu ya majani. \q Umande na mvua havimngoji mtu yeyote. \q Hakuna binadamu anayeweza kuvileta.

vi.L: Những người sót lại của Gia-cốp sẽ ở giữa nhiều dân \q như sương móc từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q như mưa rào trên cỏ, \q là thứ chẳng đợi chờ ai \q và chẳng trông mong nơi con người.
vi.B: Những người sót lại của Gia-cốp sẽ ở giữa nhiều dân \q như sương móc do {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban xuống, \q như mưa rào trên cỏ, \q chẳng chờ đợi ai \q và chẳng nhờ cậy nơi loài người.
vi.R: Những người còn sống sót của Gia-cốp sẽ sống giữa nhiều dân tộc. \q Họ sẽ như sương móc từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q như mưa rơi trên cỏ. \q Sương và mưa không chờ đợi ai. \q Không người nào có thể khiến chúng đến.

ko.L: 그리고 야곱의 남은 자가 많은 백성들 가운데 있을 것이니, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터 내리는 이슬 같고, \q 풀 위에 내리는 소나기 같을 것이다. \q 그것은 사람을 기다리지 않고 \q 사람의 자식들을 바라지 않는다.
ko.B: 야곱의 남은 사람들이 많은 백성들 가운데 있을 것이니, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 보내신 이슬 같고, \q 풀 위에 내리는 소나기 같을 것이다. \q 그것은 아무도 기다리지 않고 \q 어떤 사람에게도 기대지 않는다.
ko.R: 살아남은 야곱 백성은 많은 나라들 가운데서 살 것이다. \q 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터 오는 이슬 같고, \q 풀 위에 내리는 비 같을 것이다. \q 이슬과 비는 누구도 기다리지 않는다. \q 어떤 사람도 그것을 오게 할 수 없다.

decisions.choice: like dew from the LORD: a gift that comes from God alone
decisions.reason: In a dry land dew and showers were life for the crops, and a sign of the LORD's blessing (Genesis 27:28; Deuteronomy 32:2; Hosea 14:6). The remnant among the nations will be like that: sent by the LORD, bringing life. Some read the picture also as one of numbers, the dew covering the ground (2 Samuel 17:12).

decisions.choice: which does not wait for anyone: dew and rain depend on God, not on people
decisions.reason: No one can make the dew fall or the rain come; they come from God alone (Job 38:28). So the remnant's life and future depend on the LORD, not on the powers of the nations around it.

decisions.choice: the remnant of Jacob: the first of two pictures
decisions.reason: Verses 6 and 7 begin with the same words and give two pictures of the remnant among the nations: refreshing dew, and a lion no one can resist. It will be both blessing and judgment to them, as the nations respond (4:1-3; 5:14).

decisions.choice: the remnant of Jacob (L, B); The people of Jacob who are left (R); anyone (L); human beings (with the gender setting, L); no human being (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "sons of humankind" means people in general, so Literal has the gender setting. Readable says what a remnant is and says plainly what the last two lines mean (m2).

decisions.choice: "el remanente de Jacob" (L, B); "los de Jacob que queden" (R) for the remnant, here and in verse 7
decisions.reason: The settled wording for the remnant in the prophets (m3).

decisions.choice: "le reste de Jacob" (L, B); "ceux de Jacob qui resteront" (R) for the remnant, here and in verse 7
decisions.reason: The settled wording for the remnant in the prophets (m3).

decisions.choice: "wanadamu", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Swahili "wanadamu" already covers men and women alike, so the English gender span has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: "mabaki ya Yakobo" (L, B); "watu wa Yakobo waliobaki" (R) for the remnant, here and in verse 7
decisions.reason: The settled wording for the remnant in the prophets (m3).

decisions.choice: "con người", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "con người" already means human beings of both sexes, so the English gender span has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: "những người sót lại" (L, B); "những người còn sống sót" (R) for the remnant, here and in verse 7
decisions.reason: The settled wording for the remnant in the prophets (m3).

decisions.choice: "사람의 자식들", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "사람의 자식들" already includes daughters, so the English gender span has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: "야곱의 남은 자" (L); "남은 사람들" (B); "살아남은 야곱 백성" (R) for the remnant, here and in verse 7
decisions.reason: The settled wording for the remnant in the prophets (m3).

records.literal_gloss: And will be [the] remnant of Jacob among the nations, in [the] midst of peoples many, like a lion among [the] beasts of [the] forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, which, if it passes through, tramples and tears, and there is no deliverer.

en.L: And the remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, amid many peoples, \q like a lion among the beasts of the woods, \q like a young lion in flocks of sheep, \q which, if it passes through, tramples and tears, and there is no one to rescue.
en.B: The remnant of Jacob will live among the nations, surrounded by many peoples, \q like a lion among the wild animals, \q like a young lion prowling among flocks of sheep, \q which tramples and tears as it goes, with no one to rescue.
en.R: The people of Jacob who are left will live among the nations, among many peoples. \q They will be like a lion among forest animals, \q like a young lion among flocks of sheep. \q When a lion goes through, it knocks down its prey and tears it apart, and no one can save the sheep.

es.L: Y el remanente de Jacob estará entre las naciones, en medio de muchos pueblos, \q como un león entre las bestias del bosque, \q como un leoncillo entre los rebaños de ovejas, \q que, si pasa, pisotea y despedaza, y no hay quien libre.
es.B: El remanente de Jacob vivirá entre las naciones, rodeado de muchos pueblos, \q como un león entre los animales salvajes, \q como un león joven que merodea entre los rebaños de ovejas, \q que pisotea y despedaza a su paso, sin que nadie pueda rescatar.
es.R: Los de Jacob que queden vivirán entre las naciones, entre muchos pueblos. \q Serán como un león entre los animales del bosque, \q como un león joven entre los rebaños de ovejas. \q Cuando un león pasa, derriba a su presa y la despedaza, y nadie puede salvar a las ovejas.

fr.L: Et le reste de Jacob sera parmi les nations, au milieu de peuples nombreux, \q comme un lion parmi les bêtes de la forêt, \q comme un jeune lion parmi les troupeaux de brebis, \q qui, s’il passe, piétine et déchire, et personne ne délivre.
fr.B: Le reste de Jacob vivra parmi les nations, entouré de peuples nombreux, \q comme un lion parmi les bêtes sauvages, \q comme un jeune lion rôdant parmi les troupeaux de brebis, \q qui piétine et déchire sur son passage, sans que personne puisse délivrer.
fr.R: Ceux de Jacob qui resteront vivront parmi les nations, parmi beaucoup de peuples. \q Ils seront comme un lion parmi les animaux de la forêt, \q comme un jeune lion parmi des troupeaux de moutons. \q Quand un lion passe, il renverse sa proie et la met en pièces, et personne ne peut sauver les moutons.

sw.L: Na mabaki ya Yakobo yatakuwa kati ya mataifa, katikati ya watu wengi, \q kama simba kati ya wanyama wa msituni, \q kama mwana-simba kati ya makundi ya kondoo, \q ambaye, akipita, hukanyaga na kurarua, wala hakuna wa kuokoa.
sw.B: Mabaki ya Yakobo yataishi kati ya mataifa, yakizungukwa na watu wengi, \q kama simba kati ya wanyama wa porini, \q kama mwana-simba anayezunguka kati ya makundi ya kondoo, \q anayekanyaga na kurarua anapopita, bila mtu wa kuokoa.
sw.R: Watu wa Yakobo waliobaki wataishi kati ya mataifa, kati ya watu wengi. \q Watakuwa kama simba kati ya wanyama wa msituni, \q kama mwana-simba kati ya makundi ya kondoo. \q Simba anapopita, huyaangusha mawindo yake na kuyararua, wala hakuna anayeweza kuwaokoa kondoo.

vi.L: Những người sót lại của Gia-cốp sẽ ở giữa các dân tộc, giữa nhiều dân, \q như sư tử giữa các thú rừng, \q như sư tử tơ giữa các bầy chiên, \q nó hễ đi qua thì giày đạp và xé nát, và chẳng ai giải cứu được.
vi.B: Những người sót lại của Gia-cốp sẽ sống giữa các dân tộc, giữa vòng nhiều dân, \q như sư tử giữa các loài thú hoang, \q như sư tử tơ lảng vảng giữa các bầy chiên, \q đi đến đâu thì giày đạp và xé xác đến đó, chẳng ai giải cứu được.
vi.R: Những người còn sống sót của Gia-cốp sẽ sống giữa các dân tộc, giữa nhiều dân. \q Họ sẽ như sư tử giữa các loài thú rừng, \q như sư tử tơ giữa các bầy chiên. \q Khi sư tử đi qua, nó vật ngã con mồi và xé xác, và không ai cứu được chiên.

ko.L: 그리고 야곱의 남은 자가 민족들 가운데, 많은 백성들 한가운데 있을 것이니, \q 숲의 짐승들 가운데 있는 사자 같고, \q 양 떼 가운데 있는 젊은 사자 같을 것이다. \q 그것이 지나가면 짓밟고 찢으니, 건져 낼 자가 없다.
ko.B: 야곱의 남은 사람들이 민족들 가운데, 많은 백성들에게 둘러싸여 살 것이니, \q 들짐승들 가운데 있는 사자 같고, \q 양 떼 사이를 어슬렁거리는 젊은 사자 같을 것이다. \q 그 사자는 지나가며 짓밟고 찢으니, 아무도 건져 내지 못한다.
ko.R: 살아남은 야곱 백성은 여러 민족 가운데, 많은 백성들 사이에서 살 것이다. \q 그들은 숲속 짐승들 가운데 있는 사자 같고, \q 양 떼 가운데 있는 젊은 사자 같을 것이다. \q 사자가 지나가면 먹이를 쓰러뜨려 찢어 버리니, 아무도 그 양들을 구하지 못한다.

decisions.choice: like a lion among the flocks: the remnant will be too strong for the nations
decisions.reason: The lion is a picture of strength that nothing resists. Jacob blessed Judah as a lion (Genesis 49:9), and Balaam said Israel crouches like a lion that no one dares to rouse (Numbers 24:9). The remnant that seemed weak will master the nations that oppose it (verse 8).

decisions.choice: tramples and tears, and there is no one to rescue: the prey cannot escape
decisions.reason: The verbs are those of a lion bringing down a sheep (Hosea 5:14; Amos 3:12). "No one to rescue" is the end of the picture: the nations that set themselves against the LORD's people will find no help.

decisions.choice: The people of Jacob who are left; When a lion goes through; save the sheep (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 6, Readable says what a remnant is, and it makes the lion and the sheep explicit in the last line.

records.literal_gloss: Let be lifted up your hand over your foes, and all your enemies let them be cut off.

en.L: Let your hand be lifted up over your adversaries, \q and let all your enemies be cut off.
en.B: May your hand be raised in triumph over your foes, \q and may all your enemies be cut off.
en.R: May you win the victory over your enemies. \q May all of them be destroyed.

es.L: Que se alce tu mano sobre tus adversarios, \q y que desaparezcan todos tus enemigos.
es.B: Que tu mano se alce triunfante sobre tus adversarios, \q y que desaparezcan todos tus enemigos.
es.R: Que obtengas la victoria sobre tus enemigos. \q Que todos ellos sean destruidos.

fr.L: Que ta main se lève au-dessus de tes adversaires, \q et que tous tes ennemis soient retranchés !
fr.B: Que ta main se lève en triomphe sur tes adversaires, \q et que tous tes ennemis disparaissent !
fr.R: Puisses-tu remporter la victoire sur tes ennemis ! \q Qu’ils soient tous détruits !

sw.L: Mkono wako na uinuliwe juu ya watesi wako, \q na adui zako wote wakatiliwe mbali.
sw.B: Mkono wako na uinuliwe kwa ushindi juu ya watesi wako, \q na adui zako wote wakatiliwe mbali.
sw.R: Na ushinde adui zako. \q Wote na waangamizwe.

vi.L: Nguyện tay ngươi giơ cao trên các kẻ địch ngươi, \q và mọi kẻ thù ngươi bị trừ diệt.
vi.B: Nguyện tay ngươi giơ lên đắc thắng trên các kẻ địch, \q và mọi kẻ thù ngươi bị trừ diệt.
vi.R: Nguyện ngươi chiến thắng mọi kẻ thù. \q Nguyện tất cả chúng bị tiêu diệt.

ko.L: 네 손이 네 대적들 위로 들리고, \q 네 모든 원수들이 끊어지기를 바란다.
ko.B: 네 손이 승리하여 네 대적들 위로 높이 들리고, \q 네 모든 원수가 없어지기를 바란다.
ko.R: 네가 원수들을 이기기를 바란다. \q 그들이 모두 망하기를 바란다.

decisions.choice: Let your hand be lifted up: a wish or a promise spoken to Israel
alternatives: a prayer to the LORD: "Let your hand be lifted up"
a promise: "Your hand will be lifted up"
decisions.reason: The verbs can be read as wishes or as statements about the future. "You" is masculine singular, most likely Jacob, the remnant of verse 7. Some read the line as a prayer to the LORD to raise his hand against his enemies, as in Isaiah 26:11. It is taken here as a wish for Israel's victory.

decisions.choice: your hand lifted up: victory
decisions.reason: A raised hand is a sign of power and triumph (Exodus 14:8; 17:11; Deuteronomy 32:27).

decisions.choice: cut off: destroyed, removed
decisions.reason: The verb is the one the LORD uses four times in verses 9-12, where he cuts off what Israel trusted in. The enemies will be cut off, and so will Israel's own false supports.

decisions.choice: Let your hand be lifted up (L); May your hand be raised in triumph (B); May you win the victory (R); cut off (L, B); destroyed (R)
decisions.reason: Since the line is taken as spoken to Israel (m1), "your" takes no setting for pronouns for God. Balanced and Readable say what the raised hand means (m2). Literal and Balanced keep "cut off" so that the link with verses 9-12 shows (m3).

decisions.choice: "desaparezcan" (L, B) here, and "haré desaparecer" in verses 9-12 (L, B)
decisions.reason: One verb serves the enemies here and the false supports the LORD cuts off in verses 9-12, so the link the Hebrew makes shows at Literal and Balanced (m3).

decisions.choice: "retranchés" / "je retrancherai" (L) and "disparaître" / "je ferai disparaître" (B), here and in verses 9-12
decisions.reason: One verb serves the enemies here and the false supports the LORD cuts off in verses 9-12, so the link the Hebrew makes shows at Literal and Balanced (m3).

decisions.choice: "wakatiliwe mbali" here and "nitakatilia mbali" in verses 9-12 (L, B)
decisions.reason: One verb serves the enemies here and the false supports the LORD cuts off in verses 9-12, so the link the Hebrew makes shows at Literal and Balanced (m3).

decisions.choice: "bị trừ diệt" here and "Ta sẽ trừ diệt" in verses 9-12 (L, B)
decisions.reason: One verb serves the enemies here and the false supports the LORD cuts off in verses 9-12, so the link the Hebrew makes shows at Literal and Balanced (m3).

decisions.choice: "끊어지기를" (L) / "없어지기를" (B) here, and "끊어 버리겠다" (L) / "없애 버리겠다" (B) in verses 9-12
decisions.reason: One verb serves the enemies here and the false supports the LORD cuts off in verses 9-12, so the link the Hebrew makes shows at Literal and Balanced (m3).

records.literal_gloss: And it will be in that day, declares Yahweh, I will cut off your horses from your midst, and I will destroy your chariots.

en.L: And it will be in that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q that I will cut off your horses from your midst \q and destroy your chariots.
en.B: On that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q I will cut off your horses from among you \q and destroy your chariots.
en.R: At that time, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q I will take away your horses \q and destroy your chariots.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q que haré desaparecer tus caballos de en medio de ti \q y destruiré tus carros.
es.B: Aquel día, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q haré desaparecer tus caballos de en medio de ti \q y destruiré tus carros de guerra.
es.R: En ese tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q te quitaré tus caballos \q y destruiré tus carros de guerra.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q que je retrancherai tes chevaux du milieu de toi \q et je détruirai tes chars.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q je ferai disparaître tes chevaux du milieu de toi \q et je détruirai tes chars.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q je t’enlèverai tes chevaux \q et je détruirai tes chars.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q nitawakatilia mbali farasi wako kutoka katikati yako \q na kuyaangamiza magari yako ya vita.
sw.B: Siku hiyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q nitawakatilia mbali farasi wako kutoka kati yako \q na kuyaangamiza magari yako ya vita.
sw.R: Wakati huo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q nitawaondoa farasi wako \q na kuyaangamiza magari yako ya vita.

vi.L: Sẽ xảy ra trong ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừ diệt ngựa của ngươi khỏi giữa ngươi \q và hủy phá xe chiến mã của ngươi.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừ diệt ngựa của ngươi khỏi giữa ngươi \q và hủy phá xe chiến mã của ngươi.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cất ngựa của ngươi đi \q và phá hủy xe chiến mã của ngươi.

ko.L: 그날에 이런 일이 있을 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. \q 내가 네 가운데서 네 말들을 끊어 버리고 \q 네 병거들을 부숴 버리겠다.
ko.B: 그날이 오면 이렇게 하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 내가 네 가운데서 네 말들을 없애 버리고 \q 네 병거들을 부숴 버리겠다.
ko.R: 그때에 나는 이렇게 하겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 내가 너의 말들을 빼앗고 \q 너의 병거들을 부숴 버리겠다.

decisions.choice: I will cut off your horses ... your chariots: the LORD removes what Israel trusted in instead of him
decisions.reason: The "you" of verses 9-13 is Israel. Horses and chariots were the strength of armies, and the law warned the king not to multiply horses (Deuteronomy 17:16). The prophets condemn trusting in them rather than in the LORD (Isaiah 2:7; 31:1; Hosea 14:4; compare Psalm 20:8). In the coming day the LORD will take away every false support: weapons, fortresses, magic and idols (verses 9-13).

decisions.choice: I will cut off: four times, each verse beginning the same way
decisions.reason: The verb "cut off" opens verses 9-12 and answers verse 8: the enemies will be cut off, and so will the things in Israel that rival the LORD.

decisions.choice: And it will be in that day (L); On that day (B); At that time (R); declares (L, B); says (R); take away (R)
decisions.reason: The formulas follow the wording set for the prophets. Readable says "take away" for "cut off" where it is said of horses.

en.R: I will destroy the cities in your land \q and tear down all your forts.

es.B: Haré desaparecer las ciudades de tu tierra \q y echaré abajo todas tus plazas fuertes.
es.R: Destruiré las ciudades de tu tierra \q y derribaré todos tus fuertes.

fr.B: Je ferai disparaître les villes de ton pays \q et j’abattrai toutes tes places fortes.
fr.R: Je détruirai les villes de ton pays \q et je démolirai toutes tes forteresses.

sw.L: Nami nitaikatilia mbali miji ya nchi yako \q na kuzibomoa ngome zako zote.
sw.B: Nitaikatilia mbali miji ya nchi yako \q na kuziangusha ngome zako zote.
sw.R: Nitaiangamiza miji ya nchi yako \q na kuzibomoa ngome zako zote.

vi.B: Ta sẽ trừ diệt các thành trong xứ ngươi \q và triệt hạ mọi thành trì của ngươi.

ko.R: 내가 네 땅의 성읍들을 멸망시키고 \q 네 요새들을 모두 허물어 버리겠다.

decisions.choice: your cities ... your fortresses: walled cities, another false security
decisions.reason: Fortified cities were built for defense, and Hosea 8:14 says Judah multiplied them while forgetting its Maker. The LORD will take them away, so that his people depend on him alone.

records.literal_gloss: And I will cut off sorceries from your hand, and soothsayers not they will be to you.

en.L: And I will cut off sorceries from your hand, \q and you will have no soothsayers.
en.B: I will cut off the sorceries you practice, \q and you will have no more fortune-tellers.
en.R: I will take away your magic and your charms, \q and there will be no one left to tell your fortune.

es.L: Y haré desaparecer las hechicerías de tu mano, \q y no tendrás agoreros.
es.B: Haré desaparecer las hechicerías que practicas, \q y ya no tendrás a nadie que te diga la buenaventura.
es.R: Te quitaré tu magia y tus amuletos, \q y no quedará nadie que te adivine el futuro.

fr.L: Et je retrancherai les sortilèges de ta main, \q et tu n’auras plus de diseurs de présages.
fr.B: Je ferai disparaître les sortilèges que tu pratiques, \q et tu n’auras plus de diseurs de bonne aventure.
fr.R: Je t’enlèverai ta magie et tes amulettes, \q et il ne restera plus personne pour te prédire l’avenir.

sw.L: Nami nitaukatilia mbali uchawi mkononi mwako, \q wala hutakuwa na wabashiri.
sw.B: Nitaukatilia mbali uchawi unaoufanya, \q wala hutakuwa tena na wabashiri.
sw.R: Nitakuondolea uchawi wako na hirizi zako, \q wala hapatabaki mtu wa kukutabiria bahati yako.

vi.L: Ta sẽ trừ diệt các tà thuật khỏi tay ngươi, \q và ngươi sẽ không còn kẻ đoán số mệnh.
vi.B: Ta sẽ trừ diệt các tà thuật ngươi thực hành, \q và ngươi sẽ không còn những kẻ đoán số mệnh nữa.
vi.R: Ta sẽ cất bỏ phép thuật và bùa chú của ngươi, \q và sẽ chẳng còn ai bói toán vận mệnh cho ngươi.

ko.L: 내가 네 손에서 요술들을 끊어 버리겠고, \q 네게 길흉을 말하는 자들이 없을 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 네가 부리는 요술들을 없애 버리겠으니, \q 너에게 다시는 길흉을 점치는 자가 없을 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 너의 마술과 부적을 빼앗겠다. \q 네 운수를 봐 줄 사람이 아무도 남지 않을 것이다.

decisions.choice: sorceries ... soothsayers: magic and fortune-telling, which the law forbids
decisions.reason: The first word means spells or magic arts, the second people who tell the future by omens. Both are on the list of practices the law forbids because they look for power and knowledge apart from the LORD (Deuteronomy 18:10-12; Leviticus 19:26). Isaiah 2:6 accuses Judah of being full of soothsayers like the Philistines.

decisions.choice: from your hand: the magic you practice, or the charms you hold
decisions.reason: "From your hand" may mean the spells the people work, or the objects they use, such as amulets. Either way the LORD takes away what they hold on to.

decisions.choice: sorceries (L, B); magic and charms (R); soothsayers (L); fortune-tellers (B); no one left to tell your fortune (R)
decisions.reason: Readable uses everyday words for the two kinds of magic (m1, m2).

decisions.choice: "hechicerías" and "agoreros" (L), "decir la buenaventura" (B)
decisions.reason: The words of the published Deuteronomy 18:10 for the same forbidden practices (m1), kept apart from the diviners of 3:6-7.

decisions.reason: The words of the published Deuteronomy 18:10 for the same forbidden practices (m1), kept apart from the diviners of 3:6-7.

decisions.reason: The words of the published Deuteronomy 18:10 for the same forbidden practices (m1), kept apart from the diviners of 3:6-7.

records.literal_gloss: And I will cut off your carved images and your standing stones from your midst, and you will not bow down again to [the] work of your hands.

en.L: And I will cut off your carved images and your standing stones from your midst, \q and you will no longer bow down to the work of your hands.
en.B: I will cut off your carved idols and your sacred stones from among you, \q and you will never again bow down to what your own hands have made.
en.R: I will destroy your idols and the stone pillars you worship. \q You will never again bow down to things you made with your own hands.

es.L: Y haré desaparecer tus imágenes talladas y tus piedras erguidas de en medio de ti, \q y no te postrarás más ante la obra de tus manos.
es.B: Haré desaparecer de en medio de ti tus ídolos tallados y tus piedras sagradas, \q y nunca más te postrarás ante lo que han hecho tus propias manos.
es.R: Destruiré tus ídolos y las columnas de piedra que adoras. \q Nunca más te inclinarás ante cosas que hiciste con tus propias manos.

fr.L: Et je retrancherai tes statues taillées et tes stèles du milieu de toi, \q et tu ne te prosterneras plus devant l’ouvrage de tes mains.
fr.B: Je ferai disparaître du milieu de toi tes idoles sculptées et tes pierres sacrées, \q et jamais plus tu ne te prosterneras devant ce que tes mains ont fait.
fr.R: Je détruirai tes idoles et les colonnes de pierre que tu adores. \q Tu ne te prosterneras plus jamais devant des choses que tu as fabriquées toi-même.

sw.L: Nami nitazikatilia mbali sanamu zako za kuchonga na nguzo zako za mawe kutoka katikati yako, \q wala hutaisujudia tena kazi ya mikono yako.
sw.B: Nitazikatilia mbali kutoka kati yako sanamu zako za kuchonga na nguzo zako takatifu, \q wala hutaisujudia tena kazi ya mikono yako mwenyewe.
sw.R: Nitaziharibu sanamu zako na nguzo za mawe unazoziabudu. \q Hutasujudu tena mbele ya vitu ulivyovitengeneza kwa mikono yako mwenyewe.

vi.L: Ta sẽ trừ diệt các tượng chạm và các trụ đá của ngươi khỏi giữa ngươi, \q và ngươi sẽ không còn quỳ lạy công việc của tay mình nữa.
vi.B: Ta sẽ trừ diệt khỏi giữa ngươi các thần tượng chạm và các trụ đá thiêng của ngươi, \q và ngươi sẽ không bao giờ còn quỳ lạy những vật tay mình làm ra nữa.
vi.R: Ta sẽ hủy diệt các thần tượng của ngươi và các trụ đá ngươi thờ lạy. \q Ngươi sẽ chẳng bao giờ còn quỳ lạy những thứ chính tay ngươi làm ra nữa.

ko.L: 내가 네 가운데서 네 새긴 우상들과 네 돌기둥들을 끊어 버리겠으니, \q 네가 다시는 네 손으로 만든 것에 절하지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 네 가운데서 새긴 우상들과 신성한 돌기둥들을 없애 버리겠으니, \q 네가 다시는 네 손으로 만든 것에 절하지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 너의 우상들과 네가 섬기는 돌기둥들을 부수어 버리겠다. \q 네가 다시는 네 손으로 만든 것들에게 절하지 않을 것이다.

decisions.choice: standing stones: stone pillars set up at shrines
decisions.reason: A standing stone was a pillar set upright as a sign of a god's presence. Jacob set one up at Bethel (Genesis 28:18), but the law later forbade them because they were used in the worship of Baal and other gods (Deuteronomy 16:22; Hosea 10:1-2). Hezekiah broke them down in Judah (2 Kings 18:4).

decisions.choice: bow down to the work of your hands: worship what you yourselves made
decisions.reason: Isaiah 2:8 says the same of Judah: "they bow down to the work of their hands". Hosea 14:4 has Israel promise never again to call the work of its hands "our god". An idol is a thing made by people, and to worship it is foolish.

decisions.choice: carved images (L); carved idols (B); idols (R); standing stones (L); sacred stones (B); the stone pillars you worship (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what the stones were for (m1).

records.literal_gloss: And I will pluck up your Asherahs from your midst, and I will destroy your cities.

en.L: And I will pluck up your Asherah poles from your midst \q and destroy your cities.
en.B: I will uproot your Asherah poles from among you \q and destroy your cities.
en.R: I will pull up the wooden poles you set up to worship the goddess Asherah, \q and I will destroy your cities.

es.B: Arrancaré de en medio de ti tus postes de Aserá \q y destruiré tus ciudades.
es.R: Arrancaré los postes de madera que levantaste para adorar a la diosa Aserá, \q y destruiré tus ciudades.

fr.L: Et j’arracherai tes poteaux d’Ashéra du milieu de toi \q et je détruirai tes villes.
fr.B: J’arracherai du milieu de toi tes poteaux d’Ashéra \q et je détruirai tes villes.
fr.R: J’arracherai les poteaux de bois que tu as dressés pour adorer la déesse Ashéra, \q et je détruirai tes villes.

sw.L: Nami nitaing'oa miti yako ya Ashera kutoka katikati yako \q na kuiangamiza miji yako.
sw.B: Nitaing'oa kutoka kati yako miti yako ya Ashera \q na kuiangamiza miji yako.
sw.R: Nitaing'oa nguzo za mbao ulizoziweka ili kumwabudu mungu wa kike Ashera, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaiangamiza miji yako.

vi.L: Ta sẽ nhổ các trụ A-sê-ra của ngươi khỏi giữa ngươi \q và hủy diệt các thành của ngươi.
vi.B: Ta sẽ nhổ bỏ khỏi giữa ngươi các trụ A-sê-ra \q và hủy diệt các thành của ngươi.
vi.R: Ta sẽ nhổ các cột gỗ ngươi dựng lên để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hủy diệt các thành của ngươi.

ko.L: 내가 네 가운데서 네 아세라 목상들을 뽑아 버리고 \q 네 성읍들을 멸망시키겠다.
ko.B: 내가 네 가운데서 아세라 목상들을 뽑아내고 \q 네 성읍들을 멸망시키겠다.
ko.R: 내가 네가 여신 아세라를 섬기려고 세운 나무 기둥들을 뽑아 버리고, \q 너의 성읍들을 멸망시키겠다.

decisions.choice: Asherah poles: wooden poles or trees set up in honor of the goddess Asherah
decisions.reason: Asherah was a Canaanite goddess, and her symbol was a wooden pole or a tree planted beside an altar. The law forbade them (Deuteronomy 16:21), and Hezekiah cut them down (2 Kings 18:4). Like the standing stones (verse 12), they were rooted in the land and had to be pulled up.

decisions.choice: your cities: as in verse 10
decisions.reason: The verse repeats "your cities" from verse 10. Cities were where the shrines and idols stood. Because a list of idols would fit better here, some suggest that a Hebrew word that looks alike was meant, but no ancient manuscript is known to read differently, and the text is kept.

decisions.choice: the wooden poles you set up to worship the goddess Asherah (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what the Asherah poles were (m1).

source.text: וְעָשִׂ֜יתִי בְּאַ֧ף וּבְחֵמָ֛ה נָקָ֖ם אֶת־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will execute in anger and in wrath vengeance on the nations which have not listened.

en.L: And I will execute vengeance in anger and in wrath \q on the nations that have not listened.
en.B: In anger and fury I will take vengeance \q on the nations that have not obeyed.
en.R: In my great anger I will punish \q the nations that have not obeyed me.

es.L: Y ejecutaré venganza con ira y con furor \q sobre las naciones que no han escuchado.
es.B: Con ira y furor me vengaré \q de las naciones que no han obedecido.
es.R: En mi gran enojo castigaré \q a las naciones que no me han obedecido.

fr.L: Et j’exercerai la vengeance avec colère et avec fureur \q sur les nations qui n’ont pas écouté.
fr.B: Dans ma colère et ma fureur, je me vengerai \q des nations qui n’ont pas obéi.
fr.R: Dans ma grande colère, je punirai \q les nations qui ne m’ont pas obéi.

sw.L: Nami nitatekeleza kisasi kwa hasira na kwa ghadhabu \q juu ya mataifa ambayo hayakusikia.
sw.B: Kwa hasira na ghadhabu nitalipiza kisasi \q juu ya mataifa ambayo hayakutii.
sw.R: Kwa hasira yangu kuu nitayaadhibu \q mataifa ambayo hayakunitii.

vi.L: Ta sẽ thi hành sự báo trả trong cơn giận và trong cơn thịnh nộ \q trên các dân tộc không chịu nghe.
vi.B: Trong cơn giận và thịnh nộ, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ báo trả \q các dân tộc không vâng lời.
vi.R: Trong cơn giận lớn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừng phạt \q các dân tộc không vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 내가 진노와 분노로 \q 듣지 않은 민족들에게 원수를 갚겠다.
ko.B: 내가 노여움과 진노로 \q 순종하지 않은 민족들에게 원수를 갚겠다.
ko.R: 내가 크게 분노하여 \q 나에게 순종하지 않은 민족들을 벌하겠다.

decisions.choice: vengeance: the just punishment the LORD, as judge and king, gives to those who defy him
decisions.reason: The word is not personal spite. It is the act of the rightful ruler who puts wrong right and defends his people (Deuteronomy 32:41-43; Isaiah 35:4). It falls in anger and wrath because the wrong is real.

decisions.choice: the nations that have not listened: those who refuse the LORD's word
decisions.reason: In 4:2 many nations come to learn the LORD's ways. Those that will not listen are judged, as Israel's own false supports are cut off in verses 9-13. The verb means to hear and also to obey.

decisions.choice: anger and wrath (L); anger and fury (B); my great anger (R); listened (L); obeyed (B, R); vengeance (L, B); punish (R)
decisions.reason: Readable joins the two words for anger into one and says "punish" for the plain sense of vengeance here (m1). Balanced and Readable say "obeyed" for the verb (m2).

decisions.choice: "ghadhabu" (L, B) for chemah; "hasira" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Swahili for wrath in the prophets.
